limitations: New disposable V3 identity; no accepted brain/private migration or promotion.
Existing native action/speech decoder coordinates train; recurrent weights/moments/ages freeze. No separate text classifier or forced evaluation.
Common V8 prior history; no-request removes new teacher cues, not prior language or factual narration labels.
Unseen eat-toy is a composition/attempt probe; native inedibility and physical outcomes remain authoritative.
Induced RecoveryProtocol sleep, not spontaneous. No real SLM request or delivery.
No equal-dose V2-routing arm with this exact curriculum; profile, training mask, instruction schedule and dose differ from the older negative study.
Two successful physical verb contexts share a seed before/after induced sleep; they are not independent founder replications.
Eight-tick teaching schedule differs from assessment requests stopping after first explicit activity; speech timing transfer is unresolved.
Grounded noun pairs and unseen eat-toy composition remain negative; no promotion or full CFF-language claim.
Raw full reports, every update, measured binary, traces and recoveries remain local; duplicate evaluation arrays omitted here.
